posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Main Vaapas Aaunga hits theatres June 12 — Diljit stars in Imtiaz Ali's Partition love story alongside Naseeruddin Shah, with AR Rahman composing the music and performing a historic tribute at the Attari Border.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser drops June 10 — Alia leads the next chapter of YRF's Spy Universe alongside Sharvari, with Bobby Deol as the antagonist. One of the biggest action spectacles of 2026.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crosses ₹150 Cr in just 4 days! Ram Charan's sports drama with Janhvi Kapoor is dominating the box office, with the actor comparing the joy of working with his co-stars to the iconic Naatu Naatu experience.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai is now in theatres — Varun's romantic entertainer kicked off what's being called Bollywood's biggest June ever, with ₹1400 Cr+ at stake across 9 major releases.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer takes legal action against FWICE over the Don 3 non-cooperation directive, challenging the industry body in Bombay Civil Court. Meanwhile, his ₹300 Cr post-apocalyptic thriller Pralay begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announces she's expecting her second child with Ranveer Singh! Despite the happy news, she's back filming intense action sequences for King with SRK, while a body double handles stunts for Raka with Allu Arjun.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman delivered a soul-stirring performance at the Attari Border on June 7, paying tribute to BSF personnel with 'Maa Tujhe Salaam' as part of the Main Vaapas Aaunga promotions.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King is officially locked for Christmas 2026 — SRK's action thriller marks daughter Suhana Khan's film debut, with Abhishek Bachchan as the antagonist and Deepika Padukone co-starring.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Cocktail 2 arrives in theatres June 19 — Rashmika stars alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon in one of the most anticipated releases of Bollywood's blockbuster June lineup.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Peddi crosses ₹150 Cr at the box office as Janhvi's Telugu career soars. Director Buchi Babu Sana has apologized for controversial scenes, while reports say she's signed her third Telugu film.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR confirms a massive 4-film lineup — War 2 with Hrithik Roshan (August 14), Dragon with Prashanth Neel, Devara 2, and a new film with director Nelson. Birthday celebrations included the Dragon glimpse reveal.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik confirms his directorial debut with Krrish 4 starting this summer. War 2 with Jr NTR releases August 14, with Telugu distributors offering ₹100 Cr for the state rights alone.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun's mega project Raka with director Atlee continues to make headlines — Deepika Padukone co-stars, and a Baahubali actress has just joined the cast of this ₹500 Cr+ spectacle.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Jee Le Zaraa is officially happening — Farhan Akhtar is scouting locations in Rajasthan for the road trip film starring Priyanka, Alia Bhatt, and Katrina Kaif. Shoot begins soon.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released the heartfelt 'Siddha Bhajo' — her late father's favourite song — on June 1. The Unstoppable Tour heads to Auckland, Perth, Sydney, and Melbourne later this month with 16 shows lined up.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya stunned at Cannes 2026 for her 24th year — the sculptural 'Luminara' gown by Amit Aggarwal took 1,500 hours to craft. Daughter Aaradhya accompanied her to the L'Oréal gala.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to play the female lead in Maddock Films' Mahavatar opposite Vicky Kaushal — a grand mythological drama about Lord Parashurama set to go on floors after June.

posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Jee Le Zaraa is moving forward with Farhan Akhtar scouting Rajasthan locations for the Katrina-Priyanka-Alia road trip film. YRF is also developing a female spy actioner pairing Katrina with Deepika.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Maa Inti Bangaaram hits theatres June 19 — Samantha's action-family drama reveals she plays a newlywed hiding a dangerous past. She also disclosed Sai Pallavi was originally cast.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Jananayagan, Vijay's ₹500 Cr+ political epic, shifts from a June birthday release to a July window to avoid clashing with Yash's Toxic. Anticipation builds for what may be his final film before full-time politics.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena attended the special screening of Brown with sister Karisma and husband Saif Ali Khan on June 5 in Mumbai. She's gearing up for a major 2026 comeback after skipping the big screen in 2025.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya drew mixed reviews after its May release, with critics praising her performance as among her strongest yet. Call Me Bae Season 2 is up next.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: New mom Kiara is embracing 2026 with baby Saraayah Malhotra, calling motherhood 'the sweetest blessing.' She stepped into the year with husband Sidharth after a transformative 2025 that included her Met Gala debut.
